gh pr create --base main --head fix/7-refresh-infinite-recursion --title "Fix infinite recursion in refresh() on expired session" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fixes #7.

## Problem
`refresh()` in `src/auth.js` called itself with the same expired session, so it never returned and the page froze once the cookie expired.

## Change
- `refresh(session, fetchSession)` now returns `fetchSession()` when the session is expired, instead of recursing.
- Non-expired sessions are returned unchanged.

## Open points
- The issue says to call `fetchSession()`, but no such function exists in this repo or its history. This PR takes it as a parameter rather than inventing an import. Callers need to pass it in, and the real implementation still needs to be wired up.
- Return value is whatever `fetchSession()` returns, so it stays sync or async depending on the fetcher.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)" 2>&1
